description: has_capability_for() parity cases for the crew keys, generated from the client adaptor src/lib/permissions/adaptor.ts (D-04; Phase 3 wave 1 PP1). Each persona is seeded in company A with a current assignment on A.dra: legacyRole as profiles.role, roles as company-wide rbac_user_roles rows plus user_roles rows of company A, permissions as granted user_permission_overrides (the RBAC roles' role_permissions are removed in the test), disciplines as hw_practitioners rows. For every persona and crew key, has_capability_for(persona, key, A, A.dra) and at company level (no vessel) must be true exactly when the key is in granted[persona]. canAccessModule tables are read from AuthContext.tsx. Regenerate with node scripts/db/gen-capability-cases.mjs; never edit by hand.
